verdicts.claim: 05-02 / 05-11 / 06-33 / 06-48 / 14-11 headline: 全基因組僅 1/332,705 乾淨 somatic cis-ASM (de-confound floor)
verdicts.reason: Denominator inflation / absence-of-evidence-as-evidence-of-absence: cis-testing ran on ONLY 816 loci (all HCC1395); 331,889 rows have cis_status=NA (never tested, not refuted). Honest floor is 1/816 cis-tested (~0.12%), not 1/332,705 (~400x understatement). Numerator (HCC1395-only) and denominator (6-sample genome-wide) come from different scopes. Needs explicit 'cis-tested N=816, all HCC1395' caveat — the 1/332,705 framing implies 332,704 loci were tested and excluded.

verdicts.claim: 05-11 abstract: reliable methylation read-clustering exists at 12,868 loci but is overwhelmingly germline-allelic
verdicts.reason: Caliber conflation: 12,868 IS TAG-C (germline-allelic subset) BY CONSTRUCTION, not the count of 'reliable clustering'. Reliable-clustering tristate=12,876 (incl. some non-germline) and reliable TP+FP=11,689. Stating 'reliable clustering exists at 12,868 [=all germline-allelic]' is near-tautological since TAG-C is DEFINED as reliable AND germline-allelic — it cannot show reliable clustering is 'overwhelmingly germline' when the 12,868 figure already excludes any reliable-non-germline loci. Use 12,876 (reliable) and report what fraction is germline-allelic separately.

verdicts.claim: 05-21 / 15-09 / 15-27: latent 28,254 PERMANOVA 救回但 enrich≈base (無判別力) = characterization-only, 絕不可當 filter
verdicts.reason: Enrich≈base uses HCC1395-only base (47:1). Against the CORRECT genome-wide base (92.8:1 from discovery_venn), latent recovery at minN=15 gives TP:FP=256.5 = 2.76x base — meaningfully TP-enriched, not flat. The 'no discrimination' verdict holds only at minN=0-5 (enrich 0.90-0.98); at minN>=10 latent IS enriched. Claim is defensible as 'low-minN latent ~base' but the blanket 'enrich≈base / no judgement power' overstates: characterization-vs-weak-filter boundary is minN-dependent and not honestly disclosed.

verdicts.claim: 05-21 / 06-33 §2.3 RULE headline: 6 樣本 332,705 → 7 TAG; reliable 12,868 全 germline-allelic; cleansomatic cis 全基因組僅 1
verdicts.reason: Compound headline inherits both the cis-floor denominator inflation (816 tested not 332,705) and the 12,868=TAG-C tautology. '12,868 全 germline-allelic' is true by construction (TAG-C definition) and therefore carries no inferential weight about whether reliable clustering generally is germline. Survives as a descriptive catalog summary, but the de-confound RULE inference ('methylation is germline-allelic, not somatic') is not supported at the strength claimed from a single cis-tested sample.

verdicts.claim: 05-08 / 14-01 provenance: catalog numbers (A=1/C=12868/G=291518/total 332705) grep-confirmed, T-PROV 全 🟡→🟢
verdicts.reason: All four numbers independently grep-confirmed in catalog_tag_counts.json (A=1, C=12868, G=291518, n_loci=332705). Provenance upgrade justified — these are raw catalog counts, the LEAST contestable claims in the group. Tier-up is about traceability of the numbers, which holds; it does NOT bless the downstream interpretation.

verdicts.claim: 15-06 / 15-21: reliable 11,689 全 germline-allelic; none 態 292,762
verdicts.reason: Caliber mixing flagged by auditor stands: 11,689=reliable TP+FP (excludes 1187 reliable FN), while tristate-full reliable=12,876. none=292,762 is computed as 332705 - 11689(TP+FP reliable) - 28254(TAG-E latent) = mixing TP+FP-reliable caliber with TAG-E latent caliber; tristate none=291,552, TAG-G=291,518. Three different 'none' numbers (291518/291552/292762) circulate. Numbers traceable but the report mixes 3 calibers without a single declared convention — a reader cannot reconcile them. Needs one canonical caliber.

verdicts.claim: 15-55 / 15-58: single-pipeline (all somatic_status from ClairS-TO) → tier 封頂 ⭐3; partial_flag subset (cis/copy HCC1395-only)

verdicts.claim: 14-09 / 14-22 / 14-31: de-confound floor (catalog 🟢) robust, 永遠成立論文不垮, 可即寫
verdicts.reason: The 'floor永遠成立' robustness rests on the contested 1/332,705 framing and single-sample cis test. The RAW catalog counts are robust (survives), but the floor as an INFERENCE ('methylation does not yield clean somatic cis-ASM genome-wide') is fragile: it is one cis-tested sample, one caller, 816 tested loci. Reframe floor as 'in HCC1395, only 1 of 816 cis-testable loci is a clean somatic cis-ASM' — that survives; the genome-wide '1/332,705 不垮' framing is over-claimed.

by-self-reference risk: the '6/6 PASS' is a secondary record citing the same catalog files this audit checks. Independent grep here confirms the COUNTS (332705/A=1/BRCA2=B/sum), so the numeric verification corroborates — but '6/6 adversarial PASS' as a quality stamp re-verifies arithmetic, NOT the interpretive leaps (cis-floor denominator, latent base). A re-run that re-confirms numbers does not validate the framing.

worst: 05-02/05-11/06-33 de-confound floor headline '全基因組僅 1/332,705 乾淨 somatic cis-ASM': the denominator (332,705 sample-locus instances, 6 samples) is presented as if all were cis-tested, but cis-testing ran on ONLY 816 loci, ALL in HCC1395 (331,889 rows are cis_status=NA = never tested, not refuted). This is denominator inflation / absence-of-evidence-as-evidence-of-absence — the honest floor is 1/816 cis-tested (~0.12%), a ~400x understatement, and it leans on a single sample + single caller (⭐3). The catalog COUNTS survive; this INFERENCE does not at the strength claimed.

summary.headline_status: raw catalog counts robust and grep-confirmed; the two LOAD-BEARING inferences (1/332,705 de-confound floor + '12,868 reliable all germline-allelic') are both compromised — one by denominator-scope mismatch (816 cis-tested all-HCC1395 vs 332,705 denominator), one by by-construction tautology (TAG-C is defined as reliable AND germline). Latent 'characterization-only' is minN-dependent and overstated at high minN. Caliber chaos (3 different 'reliable' and 3 'none' numbers) needs one declared convention. 05-47 has a hard factual error (16 vs 32 cols).
